name: axiom-exam-practice
description: Practise exam-style Cambridge IGCSE, A-Level and SPM questions one at a time and have each answer marked against the mark scheme, with the model answer and explanation.

interface.longDescription:
Axiom brings exam practice into your chat. Ask for a question in IGCSE Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Biology, A-Level Pure Mathematics or SPM Matematik, and Axiom shows an exam-style question in an interactive card.

Answer in the card or in the chat. Axiom marks your answer against the mark scheme — exact matches straight away, other wording by AI marking — and shows your marks, the model answer and a worked explanation. If you are stuck, say so: Axiom shows the worked solution step by step and then gives you an easier question on the same idea. A strip at the top keeps your score for the session so you can look back.

You can also have a piece of writing marked against the exam's bands (IGCSE First Language English 0500, SPM English 1119), or run Math Skills — a timed set of ten short questions on one basic skill.

You can practise without an account. If you connect your Axiom account, your answers are saved to your Axiom progress and count towards your topic mastery, and you can open your progress page from the card. You can disconnect at any time from Connected apps in Axiom.
defaultPrompt: Give me an IGCSE Mathematics (0580) question and mark my answer.
Quiz me on IGCSE Physics, one question at a time.
I want to practise SPM Matematik questions.
